package pay

// @provenance rule: rule_struct
type Payroll struct {
	Hours int
}

// @provenance rule: rule_method
func (p *Payroll) Pays() bool {
	return p.Hours > 38
}

// @provenance rule: rule_interface
type Rates interface {
	Rate() int
}

// @provenance rule: rule_generic_func
func Max[T int | float64](items []T) T {
	return items[0]
}
